prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you need (Medicare vs ACA individual/marketplace vs small‑group/employer coverage), which side of Kansas City you’re on (Missouri or Kansas), and whether you want a local independent broker or a national/online option. I can help you find a good match — but first a few steps and resources so you can pick a qualified broker:

1. Decide what type of help you need
- Medicare (Part A/B/D/MedAdvantage/Medigap)
- Individual/family ACA marketplace plans
- Small‑business/group plans
- Supplemental/short‑term plans

2. Use these trusted ways to find help
- Healthcare.gov “Find Local Help” (for ACA marketplace and individual plans on the federal marketplace)
- Medicare.gov “Find Local Help” or your State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) for Medicare counseling
- National Association of Health Underwriters (NAHU) “Find an Agent” directory for credentialed brokers
- Missouri and Kansas insurance department websites to verify a broker’s license and complaint history

3. What to prefer in a broker
- Licensed in Missouri and/or Kansas (depending on your address)
- Independent (able to show multiple carriers) unless you want a specific carrier
- Experience with the plan type you need (ask how many clients like you they’ve served)
- Clear explanation of fees and whether they receive commissions from carriers
- Good local references or online reviews
- Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance

4. Questions to ask a prospective broker
- Are you independent or captive to one insurer?
- Which carriers/plans do you work with in my area?
- How are you compensated?
- Can you show client references or reviews?
- Will you assist with enrollment and ongoing claims/problems?

5. If you want, I can look up options for you
Tell me:
- Your ZIP code (or whether you’re on the Kansas or Missouri side of KC)
- Which type of plan (Medicare, ACA/individual, small business, etc.)

With that I can find local, licensed brokers or navigator/SHIP contacts and give 2–4 vetted options to contact. Which type of plan do you need and what ZIP code are you in?
